# Exposes Potential for Leaking Private Information via Error Messages

Error messages for failed API access (notably 404s) can include owner/repo names and suggest causes, which could surface repo details to logs and potentially to unauthorized users in multi-tenant systems.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/collectors/forge.py` — `knowledge_compiler.collectors.forge.GitHubGateway._get`

- [knowledge_compiler.collectors.forge](../component/knowledge-compiler-collectors-forge.md)
